skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the basic concepts of international trade finance, including international payment systems, trade contracts, and financial documents.
Identify and manage risks associated with international trade and payments.
Apply knowledge of international trade laws and regulations to practical scenarios.
Analyze and solve specific issues arising in international trade and payment operations.
Work effectively in teams and independently, demonstrating responsibility and ethical behavior.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral forms, using appropriate terminology and concepts.
Understand and use various financial instruments in international trade.
Perform banking operations related to international payments and trade finance.
Handle negotiable instruments and understand their legal implications.
Apply knowledge of international business laws and conventions to practical situations.
